detect_changepoints_normal: run the BOCPD detector with a normal known precision model to find level shifts in a time series
detect_changepoints_trend: run the BOCPD detector with a trend change model to find slope changes in a time series
detect_changepoints_poisson: run the BOCPD detector with a Poisson process model to find changepoints in count data
plot_changepoints: plot the detected changepoints as vertical lines overlaid on the original time series data
get_change_probability: get the changepoint probability array for each point in the time series after running the detector
